name: The Thailand Full Moon Spell
hook: Sun-soaked days, island nights and one legendary Full Moon Party.
route: Koh Samui → Koh Phangan → Koh Samui
staySummary: 2 nights in Koh Samui · 3 nights in Koh Phangan
imageNote: Moon and Samui artwork is AI-generated for atmosphere; it does not depict confirmed hotels or the booked event.
about: This is your tropical Thailand spell - from the beaches and cafés of Koh Samui to the electric nights of Koh Phangan.
closing: Come for the Full Moon. Stay for the memories.

points.title: REST, RECHARGE OR EXPLORE
points.body: Rest, recharge or head out to explore.

points.title: YOUR EVENING, YOUR PACE
points.body: Evening free for beach time, local cafés or a relaxed sunset.

days.title: Koh Samui - Island Day
days.intro: No alarms. No rush. Just island time. Spend the day exploring Koh Samui at your own pace. You can choose to:

points.title: BIG BUDDHA & WAT PLAI LAEM
points.body: Visit Big Buddha & Wat Plai Laem.

days.note: These are optional, self-paced ideas, not included guided tours.

points.title: FERRY TO KOH PHANGAN
points.body: Ferry from Koh Samui to Koh Phangan. Arrive in Koh Phangan.

points.title: GET INTO THE FULL MOON MOOD
points.body: Evening free to explore the island. Get into the Full Moon mood.

days.title: Full Moon Party
days.intro: The night we've been waiting for.

points.title: A SLOW DAY BEFORE THE NIGHT
points.body: Spend the day recovering, swimming, tanning and getting ready for one of Thailand's most iconic nights.

points.title: TONIGHT: FULL MOON PARTY
points.body: Haad Rin Beach · 26 September 2026. Dance by the sea, meet travellers from around the world and experience Koh Phangan after dark.

points.title: BACK TO YOUR KOH PHANGAN HOTEL
points.body: After the party, return to the hotel and call it a night - or a morning.

days.note: Full Moon Party entry ticket is at your own cost. Local hotel return arrangements must be confirmed. Event dates may change; reconfirm before travel.

days.title: Recovery Mode
days.intro: Last night's memories. Today's slow mornings. Take it easy after the Full Moon Party.

points.title: EXPLORE AT YOUR OWN PACE
points.body: Explore the island at your own pace.

days.note: Today has one rule: Do less. Enjoy more. Activities are optional and self-paced.

points.title: TRANSFER TO THE FERRY TERMINAL
points.body: Transfer to Koh Phangan ferry terminal.

points.title: TAKE THE MEMORIES HOME
points.body: Depart with a camera roll full of memories.

All airport transfers on a private basis
